title: Python File Handling
description: File handling is an important part of any application. Python has several functions for creating, reading, updating, and deleting files.

challenges.title: Open File
challenges.exercise: Open 'test.txt' for reading ('r'). Print 'Opened'. (Note: Just show the command)

challenges.title: Read Content
challenges.exercise: Print 'Hello' to simulate reading a file that contains 'Hello'.

challenges.title: Close File
challenges.exercise: Open a file 'f' and then close it using f.close(). Print 'Closed'.

challenges.title: With Statement
challenges.exercise: Use 'with open('test.txt') as f:' to open a file and print 'Safe'.
